tutorial.title: Find your footing
tutorial.description: Learn the app, and start a paper journal you can keep without it.

journal.title: Get or make a journal
journal.description:
Any notebook works. No notebook? Fold a few sheets of paper in half. Staple them, or punch two holes and tie them with string. Loose sheets are fine too.

Then add a note saying what you’re using. A photo is welcome as well.

want.title: Name one thing you actually want
want.description: Something that matters to you, in your own words. Type it as your note. Then write the same thing on the first page of your journal.

threeSteps.title: Break it into three steps you can picture
threeSteps.description: In your journal, under the thing you want, write three steps you can picture yourself doing. Small is fine. Then type them as your note.

why.title: Say why, out loud
why.description:
Record about 30 seconds on why you want this. It stays on your phone. Then write one line of why in your journal.

Rather not record? Tap the evidence box to change what this step asks for.

setAside.title: Set this step aside, then pick it back up
setAside.description:
Set this step aside. The app moves on and nothing is lost. Find it again under See all steps and pick it back up. Stopping isn’t failing.

In your journal, mark one of your three steps as set aside, any way you like. Then add a note here.

fiveMinutes.title: Do five minutes on your first step
fiveMinutes.description: Take the first of your three steps and spend five minutes on it. Afterwards, write what happened in your journal. Then add it here as a note.

yours.title: Make it yours
yours.description: Open Settings and try the themes until the app looks right for your eyes. Put your name or a mark on your journal’s cover. Then note which theme you picked.

paperOnly.title: One session on paper only
paperOnly.description:
Next time you work on your thing, leave the app shut and track it in your journal. Afterwards, come back and add a note about it. A photo of the page is welcome.

Then open See all steps to look at your timeline.

finish.title: Write the date and finish
finish.description:
Write today’s date in your journal and add a last note here. Then design your badge. It says you can keep a goal journal.

After that, turn the page and start your real goal.
